item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.23
item.description: - The first paste into a brand-new email in Mimestream or Mail no longer stops with "the cursor moved". Typing the first character into an empty email moves the cursor into the email's first line, and ConformTXT now knows that's the same place. - When a paste is called off after the test letter was typed, the letter is taken back out (where the app shows it's still selected), so no stray space is left behind.
